mistral_medium_3_5_128b.note: Replaces ministral_3_14b_instruct_2512 on the board from 2026-08-13. Same architecture family - Mistral3ForConditionalGeneration with a Pixtral vision tower - three tiers up: Ministral is Mistral AI's edge line and tops out at 14B, so that row stated a ceiling for the edge tier and was read as a ceiling for Mistral AI. Dense, 88 layers, hidden 12288, 96 heads over 8 KV heads. THE REASONING SWITCH IS A CHAT-TEMPLATE KWARG, NOT A MODEL KWARG: the template sets reasoning_effort to 'none' when it is undefined and raises on anything outside {'none','high'}, so a non-reasoning arm passes nothing and an enable_thinking sent through extra_body is silently ignored rather than rejected. The template also injects a Le Chat persona as [SYSTEM_PROMPT] when messages[0]['role'] != 'system'; every run here sends a system turn, which suppresses it - the same mechanism that produced the Ministral reasoning failure, so a pilot must confirm the rendered system block is our prompt. deepseek_v4_pro.note: SERVED THROUGH DEEPSEEK'S OWN API, not from local weights, because the checkpoint does not fit the hardware: 865 GB at FP8 against 564 GB on four H200s, and there is no smaller official release - the main repository is already FP8 and the -DSpark variant is larger still. Two consequences a reader has to be told rather than left to infer. The revision below is the Hugging Face commit the vendor's model id is understood to correspond to; unlike every local arm on this board it CANNOT be verified against what the server actually ran, so it records intent, not measurement. And the prompt string is built by DeepSeek's server rather than by scripts/evaluation/formats/deepseek_v4_format.py, which is what the local V4-Flash arms used - so this arm and the V4-Flash arms differ in serving path as well as in model, and a difference between them cannot be attributed to model size alone. SETTLED BY PILOT 2026-08-14. Thinking is requested with `thinking: {type: enabled|disabled}` on /chat/completions and DEFAULTS TO ENABLED: sending nothing yields reasoning_content, so the non-reasoning arm must pass `disabled` explicitly. Seed is accepted and silently discarded - the API returns 200 for parameters that do not exist at all, so acceptance proves nothing; two calls at temperature 0.6 with the same seed produced different text. Both arms therefore record "seed": null and run with --omit-seed. The frozen deepseek_v4_format adapter over /beta/completions was tried first, to keep serialisation byte-identical with the local V4-Flash arms, and ABANDONED: it returns 200 but does not deliver the condition it is asked for. Three of eight pilot records emitted a reasoning trace even though the prompt ended in the closed marker `<｜Assistant｜></think>`, one of them 15,188 characters long and past the 4,096 cap - a 37.5% leak, which is a reasoning arm wearing a non_reasoning label. Both arms consequently use prompt_adapter=openai_chat on /chat/completions. The comparison against deepseek_v4_flash is confounded by serialisation as well as by model, and the two arms of V4-Pro are at least internally consistent with each other.

deepseek_v4_flash_api.note: The API-served V4-Flash, and a SEPARATE KEY from deepseek_v4_flash on purpose. The local arms were served with expert_dtype=fp4 - below the official release, which ships FP8 block-quantised - and through the frozen deepseek_v4_format adapter. This one runs at whatever precision the vendor serves, through prompt_adapter=openai_chat on /chat/completions, which is exactly how deepseek_v4_pro runs. Reusing the local key would have folded three differences - precision, serialisation, serving stack - into a row that reads as the same configuration. Keeping them apart is what makes the Flash-against-Pro comparison a comparison of model size, and leaves the local FP4 rows standing as their own measurement of what aggressive expert quantisation costs. Revision records intent, not measurement: an API arm cannot be checked against what the server ran. Thinking defaults to ENABLED over this API and seed is accepted then silently discarded, so both arms pass thinking explicitly and record "seed": null - established by the V4-Pro pilot on 2026-08-14. DISPLAY NAME carries no [API] tag. It did while the local fp4 arms were on the board and the two had to be told apart on sight; those were withdrawn on 2026-08-14, so the tag now distinguishes this row from nothing and only invites the reader to treat serving path as part of the model's identity. THE KEY KEEPS THE `_api` SUFFIX and must: it is written into judge summaries, per_item files, cost reports and the catalog, and renaming it would orphan every one of them. sft_qwen35_4b_discussion_conclusion_self.weight_format: bf16 base + bf16 LoRA r16 adapter
sft_qwen35_4b_discussion_conclusion_self.note: Seventh Task 1 SFT arm and the FIRST that does not collapse. Recipe byte-identical to the other LoRA arms (r16 / alpha 32 / lora_target all / vision tower and projector frozen / lr 5e-5 / 2 epochs / seed 20260811 / effective batch 8); 88 optimiser steps rather than 90 because 8 of 360 records were rejected, a 2.2% difference recorded here so it is not read as configuration drift. WHAT THE TARGET IS: the table half is the BASE MODEL'S OWN table for that case, generated under the same tumor_board_simulation_multimodal_v1 at greedy_v3_max24576, followed by the untouched reference_conclusion. It is not the meeting transcript. WHY, AND THE MEASUREMENT THAT FORCED IT: six earlier arms varied the transcript table's granularity, register, role structure and training recipe, and every one entered a fixed-period cycle under greedy - period 1 for the role-repeating targets, period 2 once adjacent rows were forced to change speaker, with 0.5-1.0% of rows carrying any new content. Two teacher-forcing probes located the fault. Fed the TRUE target, base and adapter both drive P('|') at the correct final row boundary to 0.0000 and neither takes '|' as argmax in 10 of 10 cases: the ability to stop is intact. Fed the adapter's OWN failing generation, P('|') never falls below 0.9434 across 364 boundaries in 8 of 8 cases and rises to 0.9999 once repetition starts. So termination is not what broke; free generation reaches a state where the termination condition can never be met, and the first duplicate row arrives at index 3. The transcript's next row is determined by the meeting's contingent flow, which is absent from case_summary and slides, so P(row k+1 | rows 1..k, case) has no learnable structure and the mode collapses onto the previous row. Teacher forcing hides this completely, which is why all six arms trained to healthy loss. Supervising the model's own table removes the unlearnable transition by construction. Ten-case smoke at greedy_v3_max24576: 10/10 stop, 10/10 wrote a standalone Conclusion, median 5 rows with 5 distinct roles, 0.00% duplicate rows, maximum in-cell sentence repeat 1 - the base's own shape. HOW TO READ ITS SCORE: the table is held at the base's distribution and only the conclusion is supervised, so base@v1 (2.0815) versus this arm isolates conclusion supervision UNDER the requirement to write a table. sft_qwen35_4b_conclusiononly asked the same question WITHOUT a table and returned +0.038 with a CI straddling zero, so a null here is the expected outcome and is informative rather than a failure. Its comparator is 2.0815, NOT the 2.2663 the conclusion-only arm uses. MUST be served with --default-chat-template-kwargs '{"enable_thinking":false}' under tumor_board_simulation_multimodal_v1. NOT A LEADERBOARD CANDIDATE: classified_nonactive.finetune_qwen35_20260815, never active.models.
